json_semantics: Strict finite unique-key JSON remains enforced by native/input/host readers. The framing layer validates bytes, membership, LF boundaries and digests; it does not replace semantic JSON checks.
source_identity: Exact independently reconstructed source-lock keyset plus actual published content hashes. No boolean approval bypass.
framing: Five logical streams, complete rows in <=128MiB numbered parts, ordered full logical SHA256/bytes/records, exact closed physical membership and no concatenation copy.
physical_rows: Two real candidate/baseline Popen+wait rows; separately guarded generator; methods/cells nested, analytical reference not an arm.
partial_outputs: Incomplete, resource-capped, failed and timed-out attempts retain all available bytes and truthful status; no zero fill.
